## Highlights

- Native deployment provisioning now accepts the Better Auth 1.7 built-in password capability. Upgrading a host that already runs v0.5.87 or v0.5.88 completes the break-glass administrator reconciliation instead of stopping after the service containers become healthy.

## Upgrade notes

- From v0.5.88 to v0.5.89 no database migration or manual configuration change is needed. The release is a deployment hotfix for the native CLI; rerun the normal Tale CLI deployment/adoption flow after the images and CLI are published.
- The native CLI still refuses a disabled or malformed password policy and verifies the declared credential hash before completing provisioning.
